sites.loses: Legacy/retired model ids configured via OPENAI_MODEL (e.g. gpt-4-32k, gpt-3.5-turbo-0301, o1-preview) are served by Router's closest current catalog model (e.g. gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, o1) instead of the exact literal id; sampling knobs Router rejects (seed, logprobs) and n>1 fall back transparently to the original OpenAI endpoint per-request via the vendored runtime, so no behavior changes there.
sites.why: Main chat-completion call (__common_get_chat_response). Default model gpt-4o is in the Router catalog and routes unchanged. Verified with check --run against the simulator (valid /v1/responses request).

sites.loses: Same model-id substitution as above for non-default OPENAI_MODEL configs.
sites.why: Plugin function-calling follow-up call (__handle_function_call). Initially failed against Router's Responses translation because the app never appended the assistant's function_call message to history before the function-result message, so Router's chat->responses translator had no function_call item to pair the function_call_output with (400: 'No tool call found for function call output'). This was a genuine spec-compliance gap in the app (OpenAI's own legacy-functions docs require including that assistant turn) that OpenAI's Chat Completions endpoint tolerated but Router's Responses-API translation does not. Fixed by appending the assistant function_call message to conversation history in __handle_function_call before invoking the plugin (bot/openai_helper.py, both the stream and non-stream branches converge on this before the `logging.info('Calling function...')` line). Re-verified with check --run (valid request, function executed, response returned) and the repo's own compileall/import smoke test.

images.generate (DALL-E). Router has no image-generation endpoint (hard limit). Kept pointed at OpenAI directly; no change needed since this client is a different call surface than chat.completions and the images endpoint is untouched by the wrap.
audio.speech.create (TTS). Router has no audio endpoint (hard limit). Stays on OpenAI directly.
audio.transcriptions.create (Whisper). Router has no audio endpoint (hard limit). Stays on OpenAI directly.
